Project14.Name: Cedarclaw
Project14.Highlight: An AI agent, built into anything.
Project14.Details: Cedarclaw is an on-device AI agent framework that drops into almost any hardware, from screens and set-top boxes to appliances and robots. It understands plain-language requests and makes decisions right on the device, so it stays fast and private and keeps working even when the connection is weak, reaching out to the cloud only for the heavy lifting.

Project13.Name: OpenBuddy
Project13.Highlight: A funny, easy AI for the most curious minds.
Project13.Details: OpenBuddy makes the most powerful AI genuinely fun and easy, built for beginners and kids. It lives on a handheld gadget with a playful animated face: just press and speak, and it listens, understands on the spot, and talks back. The idea is simple, bring the strongest tools to the most curious minds.

Project12.Name: Antitype
Project12.Details: Antitype lets you write by speaking instead of typing. Trigger it with a shortcut, say what you mean, and it turns your voice into clean, well-phrased text, then drops it right where your cursor is in any app. It sits quietly in the menu bar and can learn the names and terms you use most.

Project11.Name: CedarBuddy
Project11.Highlight: Your AI, alive on your desk.
Project11.Details: CedarBuddy gives an AI assistant a friendly physical presence on your desk. It reacts in real time with expressions, motion, and voice, so talking to your AI feels like chatting with a little character sitting beside you. Behind the charm it connects to a cloud brain and a family of smart devices, turning conversation into real-world reactions.

Project10.Name: CedarArm
Project10.Highlight: Sees it, grabs it, hands it over.
Project10.Details: CedarArm is a robotic arm brought to life with AI. Using cameras to perceive its surroundings, it recognizes objects, picks them up, and hands them to a person. It learns new skills by watching people demonstrate them and connects to a conversational assistant, so you can direct it in plain language and watch digital AI act in the physical world.

Project9.Name: MCP AI Agent
Project9.Highlight: Integrated Agent Based on MCP Technology
Project9.Details: Last updated in May 2025. Through simple conversations, AI can now use various tools to automate the completion of complex tasks. Just like humans use apps, AI can now also utilize apps—for example, opening websites, generating files, creating 3D models, and more.

Project8.Name: AI Database
Project8.Highlight: Based on MCP+NoSQL technology, an AI chatbox that accurately and intelligently analyzes large-scale data.
Project8.Details: Last updated in April 2025. Utilizing MongoDB and MCP technology, MongoDB can perform advanced computations and filtering on large datasets, overcoming the token limitations of traditional LLMs, ultimately resulting in an intelligent database.

Project7.Name: API vs GUI Agents
Project7.Highlight: A video explaining APIs and GUI Agents.

Project6.Name: Browser Operator Agent
Project6.Highlight: An AI agent capable of operating a browser app like a human.
Project6.Details: Last updated in March 2025. By using predefined tasks, the AI agent can operate a browser like a human, breaking through the limitations of traditional web crawlers. It can perform any action within the browser and retrieve any information.

Project5.Name: Amazon AI Chat
Project5.Highlight: An AI chatbot implemented based on Amazon SPAPI data.
Project5.Details: Last updated in March 2025. The AI chatbot is capable of answering questions about Amazon data

Project4.Name: Zendesk X Netsuite Actions AI
Project4.Highlight: Retrieve Zendesk tickets related to NetSuite and automatically create or modify NetSuite data.
Project4.Details: Last updated in February 2025. Real-time retrieval of Zendesk ticket information. Utilize AI technology to analyze ticket content, identifying user intent and the type of NetSuite operations. Automatically create or modify NetSuite orders based on user intent and operation type. Provide a logging feature to facilitate administrators in reviewing the complete process of order creation and modification.

Project3.Name: Kaxi
Project3.Details: Last updated in Feb 2025. Implements 90% of Uber’s features within Chatbox, supporting user management, address selection, route selection, vehicle type selection, order creation, order completion, and more.

Project2.Name: Zendesk AI Agent
Project2.Highlight: An intelligent agent that integrates Zendesk knowledge base with ticket management operations.
Project2.Details: Last updated in January 2025. It utilizes RAG technology to retrieve information from the Zendesk knowledge base, providing users with timely responses. Users can quickly create tickets via the chatbox and communicate with ticket administrators in real-time. Administrators can swiftly view tickets through the chatbox and perform intelligent analysis of functionalities.

Project1.Name: Meeting Assistant
Project1.Highlight: A browser extension that integrates ASR, TTS, and AI functionalities into online meetings.
Project1.Details: Last updated in January 2025. Product highlights include support for customizable APIs for ASR, TTS, and AI services, enabling low-cost operation of the meeting assistant. It also supports setting different language tones for TTS and allows users to customize their own voice.
